paragraphs.zh: 步骤(iii')中，溴代试剂为溴素、N-溴代丁二酰亚胺、或者溴化氢与双氧水的组合，优选为溴素；
paragraphs.en: In step (iii'), the brominating reagent is bromine, N-bromosuccinimide, or a combination of hydrogen bromide with hydrogen peroxide, preferably bromine;
paragraphs.notes: Continuation of a claim whose number appears on the previous page; no claim marker is printed on this line. 溴素 is the Chinese trade/common term for elemental bromine (Br2); 双氧水 is aqueous hydrogen peroxide. The hyphen in N-溴代丁二酰亚胺 is printed as a short dash glyph.

paragraphs.en: In step (iv'), CF3CH2OM is CF3CH2ONa or CF3CH2OK.
paragraphs.notes: All digits in the formulae are printed as subscripts: CF₃CH₂OM, CF₃CH₂ONa, CF₃CH₂OK. Transcribed here on the baseline. Same unnumbered continuation block as the line above.

paragraphs.zh: 环磺酮制备方法，其特征在于，使用权利要求11所述的化合物作为中间体。
paragraphs.en: A process for preparing tembotrione, characterised in that the compound of claim 11 is used as an intermediate.
paragraphs.notes: 环磺酮 is translated as tembotrione (the common Chinese name for that herbicide); the characters read literally as 'cyclic sulfone ketone'. Nothing on this page defines the structure, so the reading is not determined by this page.

paragraphs.zh: 权利要求11所述的化合物用作环磺酮制备中间体的用途。
paragraphs.en: Use of the compound of claim 11 as an intermediate in the preparation of tembotrione.
paragraphs.notes: Same caveat on 环磺酮 as in claim 13.
